exam.title: Reading: University Life
exam.subtitle: Английский язык · 1 курс
exam.instructions: Read the text and answer the questions.

tasks.title: My First Year at University
tasks.text:
When Aliya started university, everything felt new. She moved from a small town to Almaty and shared a room in the dormitory with two other students. At first she found the lectures difficult because the professors spoke quickly and used many academic words.

In October Aliya joined a study group. Four students met in the library every Wednesday to compare their notes and prepare for seminars. This helped her a lot: by December her marks had improved, and she felt more confident when she spoke in class.

Aliya also learned to plan her time. She used a paper diary for deadlines and did not leave her essays until the last night. Her advice to new students is simple: ask questions, find people to study with and get enough sleep before exams.

tasks.question: Aliya's study group met in a café.
Aliya got the highest mark in her group.
Why were the lectures difficult for Aliya at first?
options: The professors spoke fast and used academic words.

tasks.question: What did Aliya use to plan her deadlines?
On which day of the week did the study group meet?
Aliya's advice: ask questions, find people to study with and get enough {{sleep}} before exams.
